name: research-writing-workshop
description: 2-Day Workshop: Research Paper Writing and Research Tools - From Research Idea to Journal Publication

scripts.html: marp --no-stdin slides/day1.md -o build/day1.html --theme slides/theme.css --html && marp --no-stdin slides/day2.md -o build/day2.html --theme slides/theme.css --html
scripts.pdf: marp --no-stdin slides/day1.md -o build/day1.pdf --theme slides/theme.css --html --pdf --pdf-notes --allow-local-files && marp --no-stdin slides/day2.md -o build/day2.pdf --theme slides/theme.css --html --pdf --pdf-notes --allow-local-files
scripts.pptx: marp --no-stdin slides/day1.md -o build/day1.pptx --theme slides/theme.css --html --pptx --allow-local-files && marp --no-stdin slides/day2.md -o build/day2.pptx --theme slides/theme.css --html --pptx --allow-local-files
scripts.build: npm run html && npm run pdf && npm run pptx
